Release notes

What's new

Every update to Stay Away From Poison Hotdogs, in plain English. Newest at the top. No version numbers you need to care about — just what changed.

The game has not launched yet, so there is exactly one entry. It fills in properly the day version 1.0 reaches Google Play.

1.0 — Rexy's first adventure Not released yet

Planned for the Google Play launch

Everything in the first version:

  • Story Mode — ten painted worlds, each ending in a goofy hotdog boss
  • ABC's — catch the alphabet from A to Z
  • 123's — count and catch from 1 to 99
  • Freestyle — endless play, no finish line
  • Stars on every level and mastery for whole worlds
  • A sticker album to fill in
  • A daily treat for coming back
  • Dinosaur friends and skins to unlock in the shop

How this page works

Each release gets a short, readable summary here on the same day it reaches Google Play. Bug-fix releases get an entry too, even the boring ones — if we changed something in your child's game, it should be written down somewhere you can read it.

Spotted something this page does not explain? Ask us.
